data.name: La Zebra Tulum, a Small Luxury Hotel
data.address: Carr. Tulum-Boca Paila 800, Tulum Beach, Zona Hotelera, 77780 Tulum, Q.R., Mexico
data.description:
This trendy beachfront hotel is 11 minutes' walk from cave diving at Cenote Kape-Ha and 8 km from the Tulum Archaeological Site.
The relaxed, airy suites offer daybeds, and decks or balconies, plus minibars, Nespresso machines and free Wi-Fi. Some have plunge pools and/or direct beach access.
Amenities include a laid-back restaurant that serves local cuisine and has a thatched roof, as well as a cocktail bar on the beach. There's also a rustic-chic spa. Parking is available.
